title: Use named table fields
summary: Lua: Use named table fields. Read book.pages.
introduction: A table can also pair names with values. A dot reads a named field.
learningObjectives: Use named table fields with Lua

blocks.text: Install Lua 5.3 or 5.4. Save each example as lesson.lua and run lua lesson.lua.

blocks.title: Use named table fields
blocks.code:
local book = { title = "Moon Trip", pages = 24 }
print(book.title)

blocks.text: The dot selects the named field title. Its value is Moon Trip.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A field that is not present gives nil.
